mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS product_id, f.volume_ml, f.description, f.source_name, f.source_url, f.source_note, COALESCE(f.taste_known, FALSE) AS taste_known, COALESCE(f.aroma_known, FALSE) AS aroma_known FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_product_feature f ON f.product_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{productId}
SELECT kind, tag FROM t_product_feature_tag WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_product_feature (product_id, volume_ml, description, taste_known, aroma_known, source_name, source_url, source_note) VALUES (#{productId}, #{volumeMl}, #{description}, #{tasteKnown}, #{aromaKnown}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceNote}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE volume_ml = incoming.volume_ml, description = incoming.description, taste_known = incoming.taste_known, aroma_known = incoming.aroma_known, source_name = incoming.source_name, source_url = incoming.source_url, source_note = incoming.source_note

INSERT INTO t_product_feature_tag (product_id, kind, tag) VALUES
(#{productId}, #{item.kind}, #{item.tag})
